summary: VanEck Avalanche ETF filed an 8-K announcing its intention to make quarterly cash distributions to shareholders from net staking income. The distributions will be funded by selling staking rewards and/or a portion of its AVAX holdings, which may affect the trust's exposure to AVAX and share price/NAV. The initial distribution is expected in July 2026, with record and payment dates to be announced. The move is designed to comply with IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-2 safe harbor for staking grantor trusts. This is a routine operational update regarding distribution policy, not a special situation.
